data.display_address: Al Jawhara Residences, Jumeirah Village Triangle, Dubai
data.long_description:
Provident Real Estate is proud to offer you this Beautiful Spacious  unfurnished studio for Sale at Al Jawhara Tower in Jumeirah Village Triangle.

Property Details:

- BUA: 457.78
- Studio apartment
- 1 Bathroom
- Kitchen
- 1 parking space allocated
- Balcony

Amenities and Facilities: 

- 24/7 security desk
- Shared swimming pool
- Shared fully equipped gymnasium
- Kid’s play area
- Cycling tracks
- 4 High-speed elevators
- 23mins drive to Dubai Mall
- 15mins drive to Palm Jumeirah
- 20mins drive to Burj Al Arab
- 15mins drive to The Walk JBR
- 31mins drive to Dubai International Airport

Al Jawhara Residences is a 29-storey residential building in JVT District 2, Jumeirah Village Triangle, Dubai and this project was developed by Tiger Properties. Jumeirah Village Triangle is one of Dubai’s most prestigious addresses. Each apartment in Al Jawhara Tower reflects a new direction of luxury and elegance in a location just minutes from major attractions.
